people.imagined: In the array chamber at night he has set down a square against a stone plate and is checking an edge with his thumb. Twice measured. The grey dust in the creases of his hands is the same grey as his robe.
people.subject: The moment: in the array chamber at night, bent over a flat slab of pale stone, he sets a steel square against its edge and glances up calmly at the viewer, one thumb resting on the line he has just checked. Face: a long, patient, grey-dusted face; deep creases holding fine grey stone powder; steady pale-brown eyes; thick grey brows; a long straight nose; a firm closed mouth; a short grey beard. Hair: iron-grey, gathered high under a small bronze crown set with a dark iron pin. Body: tall, broad-shouldered, a little stooped, with big square hands. Clothing: an elder's layered silk, a black brocade outer robe with a high collar over a deep bronze and earth-gold under-robe, three crossed collars showing at the neck, the collar edges embroidered in gold with the seven Dipper stars and mountain ridges; wide sleeves falling in long heavy folds, dusted grey at the cuffs; a broad sash with a heavy yellow jade seal and a black cord of seven knots, a small silver star pinned at the collar. Hands and objects: both hands visibly grey with stone dust ground into every crease; the steel square in his right hand and a small square flag on a staff leaning behind him, the flag plain grey silk; the slab scored with faint line patterns, no writing. Background: a dark chamber, rows of small standing stones fading into drifting mist, faint motes of gold light. Light: low warm lamp-glow from the upper left and a cool spirit-light rim along his shoulder. Power: a faint, steady ochre-gold earth qi gathers about his hands and the stone, like settling dust glittering in light. Expression: level, unhurried eyes that have checked this line a hundred times, the jaw set hard and the lips pressed thin, as if no one will move him off it.

people.imagined: At the open scales in the weigh-house she balances a coin on her fingertip as she talks, feeling its weight, and does not look at the speaker but at the coin. The black touchstone at her throat swings.
people.subject: The moment: in the weigh-house, balanced between finger and thumb she holds a silver coin up before her eyes, studying its weight, while her eyes flick across to the viewer. Face: a neat, colourless, narrow face; pale skin; flat, very light grey eyes; thin precise brows; a thin straight nose; a thin level mouth that gives nothing away; a faint line of concentration between the brows, bloodless lips. Hair: dark brown, drawn into a tight flat knot beneath a slim bronze crown and an iron pin. Body: slim, upright, exact, shoulders level as a beam. Clothing: an elder's silk, a black brocade outer robe with a high collar over a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, layered crossed collars with gold Dipper stars and ridge lines embroidered along the edges, narrow precise sleeves falling in straight folds; a broad sash with a yellow jade seal, a black seven-knot cord, a small silver star at the collar. At her throat, on a thin cord, a black jasper pendant scored with thousands of fine gold and silver streaks, plainly visible. Hands and objects: the coin in the right hand, dry fine fingertips, nails cut straight across; before her a small brass balance, one pan holding a single grey pebble. Background: shelves of brass weights in rows, blurred, a silver mist and a few drifting motes. Light: cool moonlike white light from the upper left, a thin silver rim light on her cheek. Power: a faint steel-silver metal qi shimmers in a thin line around the coin and her fingertips. Expression: flat, precise, level attention, the pale eyes sliding from coin to viewer, a diligent woman who weighs people the way she weighs silver and trusts neither.

people.imagined: On the snow ridge above Tinh Tủy Mạch at noon, narrowing his pale eyes against the glare off the stone, he is listening for a watch order that has never been read to him.
people.subject: The moment: on a bright snowfield he stands with his eyes narrowed to slits against the glare, looking out past the viewer, one gloved hand shading his brow. Face (the snow-burnt face and narrow pale eyes matter most): a lean, hard face with skin burnt red-brown and peeling, cracked lips; very pale grey eyes squeezed into slits with deep crow's-feet; short white brows; a hawkish nose; white stubble; bleached lashes and flakes of dead skin curling at his nose. Hair: white, cropped close, a pale fur-lined hood pushed back. Body: tall, lean, hard-framed, upright. Clothing: a steward's winter silks, a fur-collared long coat of dark iron-grey brocade over a deep bronze and earth-gold under-robe, crossed collars edged in gold thread with Dipper stars and ridge lines, wide sleeves cuffed at the wrist with grey fur; a sash with a yellow jade pendant, a black seven-knot cord, a small silver star at the collar; grey gloves. Hands and objects: one gloved hand shading the brow, the other on the shaft of a long spear planted in the snow. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder, rises the hilt of a fine narrow straight sword, its steel carrying a faint frost-bloom, grip bound in undyed grey ray-skin, a squared guard of dull grey steel, a scabbard of dark wood with the mouth wrapped in pale fur, a small snow-jade bead on a short grey cord at the pommel. Background: a luminous white snow slope and a blue-white vein of snow-jade, blurred, spindrift blowing off a crest. Light: pale spirit-light glare from above and left, cold blue rim light. Power: a thin ring of steel-white frost-qi motes drifts about the sword hilt. Expression: a loyal, reclusive, patient squint into the glare, cracked lips closed, a sentry still listening for an order that was never read to him.

people.imagined: On the Bridge Court bench, smiling at an advocate as he turns his jade ring slowly, listening to a toll case. He has already decided and enjoys the listening.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a judge's bench he smiles benignly at the viewer while turning a jade ring on his finger with the other thumb. Face: a plump, smooth, rosy, smiling face; small bright dark eyes in folds of fat; thin arched brows; a round nose; a soft full mouth in an easy charming smile; a double chin; a pink sheen of well-fed health on his cheeks. Hair: black, oiled, in a neat topknot beneath a gold crown with a jade pin. Body: round, comfortable, soft-shouldered, leaning back. Clothing: an elder's richest silk, a black brocade bench robe with a high collar, lustrous with sheen, over a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, three crossed collars bordered in gold stitched with Dipper stars and mountain ridges, wide sleeves pooling in glossy folds; a broad sash holding a heavy yellow jade seal, a black seven-knot cord, a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: a thick green jade ring turned on the left hand; the right hand resting on a smooth wooden gavel-block; a small brass balance on the bench beside him. Background: a dim court hall of stone pillars in drifting incense mist, a plain grey silk banner between two pillars, small shapes of advocates far off. Light: warm golden spirit-light from the upper left, a gleam on the ring and a soft rim on the brocade. Power: a gentle halo of steel-silver qi motes rises like fine dust above his shoulders. Expression: a benign, comfortable, charming smile with small eyes bright and unhurried, a man who has already decided the case and enjoys the listening.

people.imagined: At the writ office desk, ink on her right hand and her falconer's leather guard still on the left wrist, she looks up from a ledger with a glint, as if sighting a hare.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk with a brush in her right hand, she looks up sharply with a hunter's alert, glittering stare. Face: a lean, weathered, hard-boned face; sharp amber eyes with small pupils; strong straight brows; a thin nose; a thin mouth with a faint curl of a deceitful smile; a short pale scar on the chin; fine sun-lines fanning at her eyes from years of watching a far sky. Hair: black with grey, in a tight low knot under a plain bronze crown and an iron pin. Body: lean, straight, wiry, a ropy forearm. Clothing: an elder's silk, a black brocade high-collared outer robe over a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, crossed collars edged with gold Dipper stars and ridge lines, wide sleeves whose cuffs are stained with ink; a broad sash with a yellow jade seal, a black seven-knot cord, a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects (the leather guard must read): on the left wrist a thick brown leather falconer's guard, worn and plainly visible, with a tied-on cord; the right hand, black with ink, holds the brush; a thick bound ledger lies open before her; a single grey feather beside the ink dish. Background: a writ office, shelves of rolled documents, a pale mist and a few floating motes. Light: cool moonlike light from the upper left, a thin silver rim on her profile. Power: a faint steel-grey qi shimmers about the brush tip and the guard. Expression: a sharp, glittering, hunter's attention with a faint curl at the lip, a woman sighting something in the ledger as she would a hare.

people.imagined: At dusk on the barrow, leaning on her lamp-pole as the miasma-pale air moves, she coughs into her hand and does not apologise, then raises the lamp.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk in a thin pale haze she leans on a long pole with a small lamp at its tip and coughs into her fist, without apology, looking steadily at the viewer. Face (the ash-grey skin matters most): a gaunt, frail, ashen face, skin the colour of old ash; sunken dark eyes with violet shadows; thin grey brows; a sharp nose; thin colourless lips; hollow cheeks. Hair: white, long and thin, in a low braid wound round the head under a small bronze crown. Body: very thin, slightly bent, frail wrists, but planted. Clothing: an elder's silk, a black brocade high-collared outer robe over a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, crossed collars edged with gold Dipper stars and mountain ridges, immaculate, a heavy grey wool-silk shawl over the shoulders; a broad sash with a small yellow jade seal, a black seven-knot cord, a small silver star at the collar; at the throat a dried knot of pale root bound in jade wire. Hands and objects: a tall lamp-pole of dark wood with a small yellow flame in a glass at the top, held in both hands; her breath a faded mist on the air. Background: a pale miasma fog over a dark plain, a distant grave mound, faint motes drifting. Light: dim yellow lamp-glow from the left and a cold grey-silver fog-light behind. Power: a faint, tired ochre earth qi trails like pale dust from the lamp flame. Expression: a steady, unapologetic stare, a deeply lined tired face and a hard, content mouth.

people.imagined: At the harbour tavern with a wine cup in his scarred arm, laughing at a story told by himself, his voice filling the room. He wants a ship's bell with his name on it and one more winter.
people.subject: The moment: at a tavern table he roars with laughter, head back, a wine cup raised in his left hand. Face: a huge, red, soft face gone slack with drink; small bright blue eyes squeezed in folds; bushy white brows; a big nose veined red; a wide open mouth with several teeth missing; a thick white moustache; tears of laughter shining in the creases beside his eyes. Hair: white, long and thin, tied back with a sea-blue cord under a battered bronze crown. Body: barrel-shaped, once a fighter and gone soft; a huge belly; a thick neck; heavy shoulders shaking with the laugh, a thick hand flat on the table. Clothing: an elder's silk worn carelessly, a black brocade outer robe loose and rumpled with its high collar open at the throat over a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, gold Dipper stars and ridge lines still bright on the collar borders; a broad sash straining over his belly with a yellow jade seal, a black seven-knot cord, a small silver star at the collar; the left sleeve rolled back to show a long glossy burn scar from wrist to elbow, clearly visible. Hands and objects: a heavy wine cup of grey pottery in the raised hand; a small iron ship's bell on the table before him. Background: a tavern of swinging brass lamps on chains, harbour masts black through a window, a warm haze and drifting motes. Light: warm lantern-glow from the upper left, a blue-silver rim from the window. Power: a few faint blue water-qi droplets drift and glitter around his cup. Expression: a huge, loose, red-faced roar of laughter, eyes squeezed to wet slits, the booming cheer of an old man who wants one more winter and a bell with his name on it.

people.imagined: Under the open sky of a courtyard outside the seat's walls, he has a seven-string zither on his knees and has stopped himself before the first note, one hand over the strings. His fingers are tucked in his sleeves.
people.subject: The moment: seated cross-legged beneath an open sky with a seven-string zither on his knees, he presses his long fingers lightly over the strings without plucking, with a mild, wistful smile. Face: a mild, round, pleasant face; soft brown eyes; thin gentle brows; a small nose; a kind round-chinned mouth; faint stubble, laugh lines and a hint of a second chin softening his jaw. Hair: black with grey, in a loose knot beneath a small bronze crown and an iron pin, one strand across the forehead. Body: round-shouldered, soft, slouching gently. Clothing: an elder's silk, a black brocade outer robe with a high collar, clean and well hung, over a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, crossed collars edged with gold Dipper stars and ridge lines; wide sleeves pushed back from the wrists to free the hands; a broad sash with a yellow jade seal, a black seven-knot cord, a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects (the calluses must read): long fingers on the strings with thick hard yellow calluses on every fingertip, large and plain; a plain dark-wood zither with seven steel strings; dry pine needles scattered at his knees. Background: tall pines and a wide pale sky streaked with mist, a faint breeze stirring the boughs. Light: soft silvery spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle rim along the sleeve. Power: faint steel-silver and green wood-qi motes drift off the strings like pollen. Expression: a mild, soft, longing half-smile, eyes lowered to the strings, a gentle man holding back from the first note.

people.imagined: In a tavern corner with his back to the wall, he has just seen a woman at the far table and has gone completely still, his hand flat on the table. He wears no sect colours; the lightning-tree burns glisten on his neck.
people.subject: The moment: sitting in a corner with his back to a wall he stares fixedly across the room, perfectly still, one scarred hand flat on the table. Face (the lightning-burn scars matter most): a lean, hard, wiry face; branching, fern-like red scars of lightning burns crawling up the left side of the neck and across the cheek, bright pink-red against pale skin; narrow black eyes; thin black brows; a hooked nose; a thin cruel mouth. Hair: black, long and unkempt, bound at the nape with a strip of dark silk. Body: wiry, tense, a hunter's coiled stillness. Clothing: a hired guest's dress, not a disciple's: a long dark charcoal silk travelling robe with a high collar, fine and well made, two crossed collars showing, wide sleeves narrowed by black wrist-guards of lacquered silk, a charcoal sash with a plain dark jade pendant; no sect colours, no grey, no cord, no bronze; a thin line of stitching along the coat's inner edge showing at the open cuff. Hands and objects: the scarred hand flat on a table; beside it, leaning on the wall, the White Wind Hook, a long sword with a pale steel blade whose tip curls back into a hook, its grip wrapped in dark worn cord. Background: a dim tavern wall and a lamp, a thin drifting smoke. Light: low amber lamp-glow from the lower left and a cold silver rim on the scars. Power: a faint ember-red fire qi flickers about the hook, with a pale flash of violet at the scars. Expression: a frozen, hard stare with narrowed eyes and a tight jaw, the face wholly still, the lightning scars pale on the neck.

people.imagined: Alone in the archive, he lifts a page to his nose and sniffs, a clerk's habit. While his master naps he is pressing her key into a wax block. He has stopped, hearing a step.
people.subject: The moment: among low shelves he stands bent at the waist holding a sheet of old paper to his nose, sniffing, eyes rolled sideways toward the viewer as if a footstep were heard. Face: a long, pale, narrow face; large pale watchful eyes; thin high brows; a long thin nose; a thin mouth held in slight tension; dry papery skin; a thin line of sweat at his temple despite the cool of the archive. Hair: black going grey, thin, tied in a knot with a bronze pin. Body: very tall, stooped, thin, long arms, the stoop of a man who works under low shelves. Clothing: an inner disciple's graceful silk, a dark iron-grey over-robe with a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, two crossed collars with fine gold Dipper stars on the borders, long sleeves slightly ink-spotted at the cuffs; a bronze-brocade sash with a small yellow jade pendant, a black seven-knot cord; a thin cord of brass keys at his neck, empty of a keeper's key-cord. Hands and objects: a sheet of yellowed paper with only faint stains, no writing, held to his nose; in the other hand a small block of soft wax half hidden inside his sleeve. Background: tall dim shelves of scrolls in boxes, narrow aisles running off into shadow, fine gold dust hanging in the lamplight. Light: low yellow lamp-glow from the left, a faint silver rim light. Power: a thin steel-grey qi glimmers on the paper edge, subtle. Expression: a thin, held, watchful tension, wide pale eyes rolled toward an unseen footstep, the mouth tight, the quiet alarm of a man caught half-way through a theft.

people.imagined: In the court clerk's office with a thick ledger open on her forearm like a tray, she pulls the lead pencil from behind her ear and begins to copy, careful that nobody sees which page.
people.subject: The moment: standing with a heavy ledger held open on her left forearm, she draws a lead pencil from behind her ear with her right hand and looks to the side with caution. Face: a plain, honest, oval face; clear light-brown eyes; level thin brows; a straight nose; a small firm mouth; no ornament, a face built to be trusted; a faint dent between the brows from a long habit of frowning. Hair: black, pinned in a flat bun with a small bronze hairpin, a lead pencil tucked behind the right ear, a few grey strands at the temples. Body: slim, middle height, upright, steady. Clothing: an inner disciple's silk, a dark iron-grey over-robe over a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, two crossed collars, borders with a modest gold ridge-line embroidery, well pressed and fine but plain in cut, long sleeves with ink-stained cuffs; a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord, no jade seal. Hands and objects: a large ledger open on her forearm with only rows of tidy tick marks and ruled lines, no letters; the pencil in her right hand; at her feet a ceramic rice jar with a lid. Background: a plain court office, a high window, shelves of boxes in soft mist, a shaft of grey window light picking out dust above the boxes. Light: cool moonlike light from the upper left and a soft silver rim. Power: none beyond a very faint steel-grey shimmer at the pencil tip. Expression: a plain, honest, guarded face, eyes slid to the side and lips pressed together, the quiet fear of a careful woman who is copying what she should not.

people.imagined: In the rain at the gate of the Tower, in a rain cape, counting under his breath: the men on the wall, the carts, the forges' smoke. He looks like no one; that is his trade.
people.subject: The moment: standing in light rain in a rain cape with the hood up, lips moving in a silent count, eyes flicking to the left. Face (utterly forgettable matters most): an average, unremarkable face; neither young nor old; medium brown eyes; ordinary straight brows; a straight average nose; a closed neutral mouth; a small smile held ready; rain beading on his eyelashes and running down one cheek unnoticed. Hair: ordinary brown, short, damp, mostly under the hood. Body: middle height, middle build, narrow shoulders under the cape. Clothing: a long grey rain cape of oiled silk-and-hemp with a hood, parted at the front to show an inner disciple's dark iron-grey over-robe and bronze and earth-gold under-robe with crossed collars edged in thin gold stitching; a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord, a small silver star at the collar barely visible; dark boots. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted slightly with one finger ticking the air; a small folded oilcloth packet in the left. Background: a rainy stone wall, a gate with torches, a blur of carts, a wet torch hissing in its bracket, the glow of a distant forge on low cloud, silver rain-mist. Light: soft grey-silver rain-light from the upper left with a faint blue rim. Power: none, a faint steel-grey shimmer on the raindrops at most. Expression: a patient, bland, closed look with a small smile held ready, an ordinary face that gives a watcher nothing at all to remember.

people.imagined: On the training ground at dawn, a silent, heavy man stands with a spear planted, and slowly flexes his hands. The black-iron dust is ground into his knuckles for good. He is listening for an order that is not spoken.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn on a stony training ground he stands with the butt of a long spear planted in the ground and flexes his big right hand slowly, looking directly at the viewer without a word. Face: a heavy, silent, square face; tanned dark skin; steady flat dark eyes; thick black brows; a flat broken nose; a thick closed mouth with no sign it has ever spoken; a heavy jaw; a faint pale scar at the corner of his chin; ears lying flat to the skull. Hair: black, short, cut square under a plain bronze headband. Body: heavy and broad, thick-necked, powerful shoulders, a very big man. Clothing: an inner disciple's silk cut for the spear, a dark iron-grey over-robe with tight sleeves bound at the wrist, bronze and earth-gold under-robe, two crossed collars with gold ridge lines on the borders; a bronze sash and a black seven-knot cord, no star. Hands and objects (the iron dust must read): the knuckles and backs of both hands grey-black, ground with black-iron dust, shining slightly like graphite; a long spear with a long heavy black iron blade planted beside him. Background: dawn mist over a stone ground, a line of upright spear racks in grey haze, a thin pale band of dawn along a ridge. Light: cold pale dawn spirit-light from the upper left, a silver rim on his jaw. Power: a thin steel-grey qi haze clings to the spear blade. Expression: a flat, steady, silent stare, brows low and jaw set, the heavy patience of a man listening for an order that has not been spoken.

people.imagined: Kneeling at a boundary stele on the western ridge, he runs his thumb along the cut edge of a letterless carved line, a chisel in his belt, easing the whole stone a rope's length. He has told his son.
people.subject: The moment: crouched beside a tall grey boundary stele with one grey-dusty palm laid flat on its surface and his other hand on a chisel at his belt, he looks to the viewer with a calm, level gaze. Face: a weatherbeaten, square, calm face with grey stone dust in the creases; steady grey-brown eyes; thick brows; a broad flat nose; a firm mouth; a short stubbly grey beard. Hair: grey, cropped, with dust in it, a plain bronze band. Body: broad, solid, a mason's thick forearms and wrists. Clothing: a steward's silk, a dark iron-grey over-robe over a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, crossed collars edged with gold ridge lines, dusted with pale stone powder at the knees and sleeves, the sleeves tied back with cords; a bronze sash with a small yellow jade pendant, a black seven-knot cord, a small silver star at the collar; a dark brocade work-cloth over the front, graceful and clean. Hands and objects: both palms grey with stone dust never fully washed out, clearly visible; a steel chisel and a small mallet at the belt; a rope looped round the foot of the tall plain grey stele beside him, which bears only abstract carved notches. Background: a windy ridge and a distant pale line of steles in drifting mist. Light: clear silver spirit-light from the upper left, a gold rim on the dust. Power: a faint ochre earth-qi shimmer rises from the stone under his palm. Expression: a calm, honest face with lowered patient eyes on the stone and a steady quiet mouth.

people.imagined: At the outer gate on the mountain, she lifts the heaviest weight on the rack one-handed, without effort, while a herder's child watches. She is thinking about the beam no one can pity.
people.subject: The moment: at a weight rack she lifts a big round grey stone weight easily with one hand at shoulder height and looks kindly but firmly at the viewer. Face: a short, broad, tough, kindly face, weathered and ruddy like a herder's; small brown eyes; thick straight brows; a wide flat nose; a wide firm mouth; sun lines; cheeks flushed with wind; a small gap between the front teeth. Hair: black with grey, in two thick braids pinned across the top with bronze pins. Body: short, very broad, shoulders and arms like a herder's, forearms like bundles of rope. Clothing: a steward's silk beneath a thick yak-wool coat of undyed grey-brown worn open over the shoulders, the silk a dark iron-grey over-robe and bronze and earth-gold under-robe with crossed collars edged in gold ridge lines, sleeves rolled; a bronze sash with a yellow jade pendant, a black seven-knot cord, a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: a big round grey stone weight with a ring handle lifted one-handed; a long flat wooden beam with notches leaning against the rack. Background: a stone gate, a row of grey weights on a rack, a pale-grey cloud bank, a small child by a sheep far off, barely in focus. Light: bright mountain spirit-light from the upper left, a gold rim on her braids. Power: a soft ochre earth-qi glow gathers about the lifted stone. Expression: a kind, firm, unhurried look, the corners of the wide mouth just lifted, the immovable calm of a woman who will not pity the child and will not leave her.

people.imagined: In a corridor, half a step ahead of his master, his jaw tight, glancing back at the girl heir behind them. He wants the Seal for the old man and he does not mind who sees it.
people.subject: The moment: in a stone corridor he strides forward but turns his head sharply to glare back over his shoulder at the viewer, jaw set. Face: a square-jawed, restless, handsome face; tanned skin; hard dark eyes under heavy straight brows; a strong nose; a thin mouth held in a sneer; a small vertical scar between the brows. Hair: black, in a high tight knot with a bronze crown-clasp and an iron pin, a few escaped strands stuck to the sweat on his temple. Body: tall, broad-chested, a duellist's athletic lean. Clothing: an inner disciple's silk, a dark iron-grey over-robe sharp and pressed over a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, two crossed collars edged with gold Dipper stars, sleeves bound with cords to the wrist; a bronze sash tied tight with a black seven-knot cord and a yellow jade pendant, a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: the right hand on the hilt of a straight sword at the left hip; the left hand clenched. Background: a long stone corridor with a pillar and a hanging lamp, another disciple walking away small and blurred, pale mist at the floor. Light: cool moonlike spirit-light from the upper left, a silver rim on his cheek. Power: a crisp steel-silver qi gleams along the sword hilt and scabbard mouth. Expression: a sharp, impatient glare with a clenched jaw and narrowed eyes, brows hard.

people.imagined: At the guest forge he laughs so loud it carries to the gate, a leather apron over the guest's blue, burn-flecked forearms folded, as the guard hands him a worn blade he will reforge twice.
people.subject: The moment: at a forge he throws his head back in a huge laugh, arms folded across his chest, a tankard in one hand. Face: a big, ruddy, handsome face; sunburnt; a thick short black beard with a few grey hairs; bright brown eyes crinkled with laughter; thick arched brows; a big nose; a wide open mouth with strong white teeth. Hair: black, in a loose knot tied with a red silk sweat-cloth, soaked dark at the edge. Body: big, broad, barrel-chested, strong smith's arms. Clothing: a guest's silk, a deep blue robe with two crossed collars, wide sleeves rolled to the elbow, trimmed with a thin bronze-gold border at the hem and collar to show the house he serves, a dark brocade smith's wrap tied at the waist; blue, not grey; no star, no seven-knot cord. Both forearms are flecked with small pale burn spots, clearly visible. Hands and objects: a tankard of dark ale in one hand; a long spear-point and a hammer on the anvil behind him. Background: a forge of red-orange glow, hanging tongs, drifting sparks like motes; a young guard waits with a chipped blade across his arm, and a stack of dull spearheads lies on a bench. Light: orange forge glow from the lower left and a cool silver rim from above. Power: a few ember-red fire-qi sparks float up around the hammer. Expression: a huge open-mouthed laugh with crinkled eyes and flushed cheeks, the head thrown back.

people.imagined: In a borrowed yak-wool coat in the outer gate yard, cheerfully showing a classmate her inky finger. In her sleeve a pebble filed to a Metal forty's weight sits heavy.
people.subject: The moment: in a stone yard she holds up her ink-stained right forefinger with a bright, round-faced grin as if to show off, a thick borrowed coat swallowing her. Face: a round, cheerful, rosy face; bright brown eyes; soft arched brows; a small button nose; a wide smile; dimples; cheeks rosy from the cold; a small smudge of ink on the chin. Hair: black, in two short buns tied with grey silk ribbon. Body: round, small, her shoulders lost in a too-big coat. Clothing: an outer disciple's simplest graceful silk, a soft grey over-robe with a single crossed collar edged in a thin line of bronze thread, wide sleeves under a borrowed thick coat of undyed grey-brown wool-silk, too large, the sleeves rolled up in thick cuffs; a plain bronze-grey sash with no cord and no star. Hands and objects: the forefinger of the right hand stained black with ink to the first knuckle; in the left hand a small grey round pebble, smooth and polished. Background: a stone gate yard with other herders' children, a distant weight rack, a soft pale mist. Light: bright spirit-light from the upper left, an even grey glow picking out the wool of the oversized coat. Power: none, only a tiny ochre earth-qi sparkle on the pebble. Expression: a bright, round-faced grin with sparkling eyes, open and guileless, the cheeks pushed high.

people.imagined: On a bare ridge in dry wind, her hair standing up with static, her left foot tapping, a burn scar on one palm. She has the brass ring of an offer she means to refuse.
people.subject: The moment: on a windy ridge she stands with hair standing up in a wild halo, her left foot caught mid-tap, and a sharp challenging grin at the viewer. Face: a small, sharp, brown face; bright quick dark eyes; strong thin brows; a pointed little nose; a thin, mocking, impatient mouth; a thin cut healed to a pink line over one eyebrow; windburnt cheeks. Hair (matters most): dark brown hair standing straight up and outward in a frizzed halo of static, strands floating, clearly electric, with one small bronze hairpin barely holding a knot. Body: small, wiry, taut, up on the balls of her feet. Clothing: an inner disciple's silk, a dark iron-grey over-robe with sleeves bound tight with cords over a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, two crossed collars edged with gold ridge lines; a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord, no star. Hands and objects: the left palm held open and up, showing a glossy round burn scar in the centre; the right hand holding a small black stone that gives off a faint violet-white spark. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder, rises the hilt of a plain narrow straight sword, its grip wrapped in dry grey wool yarn rubbed shiny, a plain iron guard with one corner notched, a scabbard of charcoal lacquered wood with a faint violet sheen in the black like a bruise, and a single thread of herder's rope for a tassel. Background: a dry slope, dry grass bent flat, a bruise-coloured cloud bank boiling on the horizon with pale lightning forks far away. Light: sharp white spirit-light from the upper left with pale violet sparks. Power: thin violet-white thunder-qi arcs crackle between her hair strands and the stone. Expression: a sharp, bright, challenging grin with the chin up, eyes dancing, the mouth sharp at the corner, a girl about to say no to your face.

people.imagined: In the map room, with a roll of the great map on his shoulder, his eyes flick to the door before he answers anything. He shows visitors the older copy.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a map room with a thick roll of parchment resting on his shoulder, he glances toward the doorway before turning his gaze to the viewer. Face: a thin, pale, cautious face; large watchful grey eyes with dark rings; thin level brows; a narrow nose; a closed thin mouth with a slight lie in it; fingertips grey with chalk and a thin line of ink under one thumbnail. Hair: black with grey, in a small knot with a dark bronze pin. Body: slight, round-shouldered, with a hard callus-pad on the right shoulder showing through the silk where rolls rest. Clothing: an inner disciple's silk, a dark iron-grey over-robe over a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, crossed collars edged with gold ridge lines, long sleeves ink-spotted at the cuffs; a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord; the silver star missing, only the collar plain. Hands and objects: a thick roll of plain unmarked parchment on the right shoulder; a long wooden map-rod in the left hand; behind him two identical rolls on a table, one yellowed with age, one newer. Background: a long table, hanging maps as plain coloured shapes with no writing, a dark doorway, brass lamps low over the table, rolled maps in baskets along the walls in soft mist. Light: warm dim lamp-glow from the upper left, a cool silver rim on his hair. Power: a faint steel-grey qi glints at the rod tip. Expression: a quiet, watchful stillness, tired eyes and a closed mouth, the calm of a man who keeps two truths and has practised never letting either show.

people.imagined: At a great sect's gate, he coughs a long, rattling cough, one hand on the club at his belt, before he delivers the summons. The smell of sulphur follows him in.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a gate he doubles slightly over a hard cough with his fist at his mouth, but his eyes stay fixed hard on the viewer. Face: a heavy, pitted, yellowish face with sallow skin tinged sulphur-yellow; small hard dark eyes; thick black brows; a broken wide nose; a thick grim mouth behind the fist; short black stubble; faint sulphur-yellow dust in the lines beside the nose and cracked dry lips. Hair: black, shaved short at the sides, a topknot bound with a bronze ring. Body: short, thick-set, massive forearms, a mining-boy's barrel chest. Clothing: a steward's silk, a dark iron-grey over-robe over a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, crossed collars with gold ridge-line edging, a bailiff's dark lacquered brocade vest over it; a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord, no star. Hands and objects: a short thick wooden club hanging from his belt on a loop worn shiny and dark, clearly visible; a blank summons rolled in grey cord in his other hand. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder, rises the hilt of a well-made narrow straight sword, its grip bound in cord gone the yellow-grey of old tallow from sulphur, a plain bar guard of dull grey iron, a scabbard of grey-brown leather over wood with a yellow sulphur stain that will not wash out at the throat. Background: a stone gate with two heavy doors banded in dark iron, a grey silk banner snapping in a gust, silver mist. Light: hard white spirit-light from the upper left. Power: a thin steel-grey qi tinged yellow trembles along the sword scabbard. Expression: a stern, unmoved, hard-set look above the coughing fist, the cold justice of a man who delivers summons the way he delivers blows.

people.imagined: At the witness-house door, spreading both hands in welcome; the rings glitter on all ten fingers. He is already working out what the guest will pay for the bed.
people.subject: The moment: at an inn door he spreads both hands wide in a grand welcome toward the viewer, ten rings catching the light. Face: a round, sleek, smiling face, smooth and ruddy; bright dark eyes; thin arched brows; a small round nose; a wide easy practised smile; a thin black moustache. Hair: black, oiled, in a topknot with a jade pin tipped in gold and a small bronze crown, a single grey lock combed carefully over each temple. Body: plump, tall, a host's open posture. Clothing: a steward's rich silk, a dark iron-grey over-robe of excellent cut over a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, three crossed collars bordered in gold Dipper stars, wide sleeves lined in a subtle dark red that shows only as he spreads his arms; a bronze brocade sash with a yellow jade pendant, a black seven-knot cord, a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects (the rings must read): ten rings, one on each finger, gold, jade and silver, large and clearly visible on spread hands; a pair of dice in a small cloth pouch hanging at the belt. Background: an inn doorway with lanterns and a row of seven identical doors fading into golden mist. Light: warm lantern-glow from the upper left, glinting off every ring and sheening his cheeks. Power: a faint steel-silver sparkle of qi leaps between the rings. Expression: a wide, oily welcoming smile with raised brows and eyes already sliding toward the viewer's purse.

people.imagined: Writing the monthly letter at a desk in an alien lake-sect's guest room; she is perfectly straight-backed, her brush poised. She will laugh when she reads the reply aloud, to nobody, later.
people.subject: The moment: at a low desk she sits very upright with a brush poised over paper, her face turned politely toward the viewer. Face: a fine, narrow, pale, noble face; calm dark eyes; thin elegant brows; a straight nose; a small mouth held in a courteous almost-smile; clear skin finely lined at the eyes, a faint blush from the warmth of the tea. Hair: black, in a tall neat bun with a small bronze crown and a dark wood pin. Body: tall, slim, a back as straight as a drawn bow, an elegant long neck. Clothing: an inner disciple's finest silk, a dark iron-grey over-robe of excellent cut over a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, three crossed collars edged with gold Dipper stars and ridges, narrow sleeves in clean long folds; a bronze brocade sash with a yellow jade pendant, a black seven-knot cord, a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: a fine brush poised in the right hand; a sheet of pale paper with faint ruled lines and no writing; a small porcelain cup of tea at her elbow; beyond a window a pale-blue lake. Background: a guest room with a screen painted in soft green and silver lake reeds, the window showing pale water and a single distant sail, a light mist. Light: cool silvery moonlike light from the upper left, reflected off water. Power: a faint steel-silver qi gleams around the brush tip. Expression: a composed, courteous half-smile and cool eyes, a diplomat's polish laid over a private amusement she will save for later.

people.imagined: Landing, windblown, from a crane; he rubs his bruised hip when nobody is watching, a feather in his hair and a grin. The crane preens behind him.
people.subject: The moment: standing beside a tall white crane just after landing, he rubs his hip with one hand while grinning widely at the viewer, windswept. Face: a lean, tanned, cheerful face; bright brown eyes with crow's-feet; thin dark brows; a long nose; a wide boyish grin; a few days of stubble; cheeks and nose flushed by wind and exertion. Hair (matters most): black hair tangled by wind with at least four white and grey crane feathers caught in it, clearly visible, a bronze hairpin hanging askew. Body: lean, tall, loose-limbed, a courier's wiry frame. Clothing: an inner disciple's travelling silk, a dark iron-grey over-robe wind-rumpled over a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, crossed collars edged with gold ridge lines, a long courier's scarf of grey silk streaming; a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord a little loosened; a leather satchel across the chest. Hands and objects: one hand on his hip, the other holding a coil of rope reins; beside him a tall white crane with black wing tips and a red crown, its long neck craning toward him. Background: open sky and distant misty peaks, high cirrus streaking the blue, a far ridge catching a bar of gold light behind the crane's folded wing. Light: bright windy spirit-light from the upper left, a gold rim on the feathers. Power: a few steel-silver qi motes ride the wind off the crane's wings. Expression: a wide, breathless, boyish grin with bright eyes, thrown from the crane twice already and keen to go up a third time.

people.imagined: On the seat's drill ground at dawn, blowing the whistle on its cord, frost-cracked lips pulling back, the guard before him in rows. He has just shouted and is judging who will fall.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn on a frosty drill ground he blows a brass whistle held in his teeth with his left hand raised, two fingers missing, and glares at unseen ranks. Face: a hard, lined, ruddy face; icy blue eyes narrowed; heavy straight white brows; a broken nose; cracked, raw, frost-split lips around the whistle; a stubbly grey jaw; frost clinging to the stubble, his breath a dense white cloud. Hair: grey, cropped to a brush. Body: tall, broad, tough, a drillmaster's iron posture. Clothing: a steward's silk, a dark iron-grey over-robe over bronze and earth-gold, crossed collars with gold ridge lines, with grey lacquered scale plates over the shoulders; a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord and a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: the left hand raised in a commanding gesture with only three fingers, the last two missing, plainly visible; the whistle on a cord at his teeth; the right hand holding a long wooden drill staff. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder, rises the hilt of a well-made straight double-edged sword, its grip bound in thick black-dyed leather cut wide and deep-grooved for a hand missing two fingers, a heavy flat guard of grey iron, a scabbard of grey oiled hide split by frost along the seam and stitched with waxed thread, and a plain iron ring at the pommel. Background: a misty drill ground with rows of grey figures in breath-steam, a second bank of mist hiding the far end of the field, the tops of spears showing. Light: cold pale dawn spirit-light from the upper left, a blue-silver rim. Power: a faint steel-white frost-qi swirls about the sword hilt. Expression: lips pulled back over his teeth, a hard squinting stare with deep furrows between the brows, judging the line.

people.imagined: In a ruined beacon fort at night, soot to the elbows, turning a flint-striker over and over, while a fire basket stands ready. Others fidget; she does not. She is quietly relighting the old line.
people.subject: The moment: crouching beside an iron fire basket filled with kindling, she turns a flint-striker in her black fingers, intent, with one dark eye lifted to the viewer. Face: a sharp, soot-smudged, determined face; dark intense eyes; strong straight brows; a straight nose; a firm mouth; a smear of soot across one cheek, sweat cutting clean lines through it at the temple. Hair: black, tied in a tight bun wrapped in dark silk with a bronze pin. Body: lean, wiry, sleeves rolled up. Clothing: an inner disciple's silk, a dark iron-grey over-robe with the sleeves rolled to the shoulder over a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, crossed collars with gold ridge-line edging; a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord, no star; a dark brocade work-cloth tied over the front. Hands and objects (the soot must read): both forearms black with soot to the elbow, a clear sharp line where clean skin ends; a steel flint-striker and a flint in the hands; an iron fire basket full of dry kindling. Background: a dark stone beacon fort, broken battlements against a sky of cold stars, a jagged line of dark ridges running away. Light: a small orange spark and a faint warm glow from below, cold blue night-light above. Power: ember-red fire-qi sparks drift upward and cling to her fingers. Expression: a calm, hard-eyed focus, mouth set and brows level, the unflinching patience of a woman relighting a dead line one spark at a time.

people.imagined: In the array chamber at dusk, standing, lighting the seventh of the seven anchor candles. Wax scars her palms and her heavy eyelids droop; she has not sat down in forty years.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk, standing beside a row of tall candles, she holds a taper to light the last one and looks drowsily at the viewer with heavy eyelids. Face: a long, pale, still face; large dark eyes with very heavy drooping lids; thin straight brows; a long nose; a thin calm mouth; faint shadows under the eyes. Hair: black, in a long single braid wound up in a coil and pinned with a bronze crown-pin. Body: tall, slim, standing perfectly straight, a body that does not sit. Clothing: an inner disciple's silk, a dark iron-grey over-robe immaculate over a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, crossed collars edged with gold Dipper stars, wide sleeves in long still folds; a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord, a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects (the wax scars must read): both palms and fingers spotted with small shiny pale scars of candle wax, like droplets, plain on the hand holding the taper; seven tall white candles in a curved row, six lit, one dark; seven small standing stones at their feet. Background: a dark chamber with a pale circle of floor marks, a faint golden mist. Light: warm candlelight from the lower left, many small flames, and a soft silver rim. Power: a faint ochre earth-qi glow rises from the standing stones to meet the flames. Expression: a calm, heavy-lidded face with a drowsy half-open gaze and a quiet, patient mouth.

people.imagined: At dawn on the vein's wall, she has climbed a stair slowly, favouring her knees, and pauses to look over the bright snow. Her pale lashes blink in the glare.
people.subject: The moment: on a stone stair at dawn she stops with one hand on her knee and the other on a wall, looking up into bright light. Face (pale lashes matter most): a pale, fine, honest face; very pale, nearly white eyelashes framing bright grey-blue eyes that blink in the glare; thin fair brows; a straight nose; a gentle mouth; faint freckles; a few pale strands worked loose shining at her temple. Hair: pale brown, in a long loose braid pinned up in a crown with a bronze pin. Body: slender, medium height, knees slightly bent and stiff, a careful gait. Clothing: an inner disciple's silk, a dark iron-grey over-robe with a heavy grey silk-wool shawl over a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, crossed collars edged with gold ridge lines; a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord, a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: a small grey array-anchor stone in the right hand, faintly glowing white; the left hand on her knee. Background: a snow-slope under a bright white sky, a row of upright stones along the wall, frost whitening the stair edges, the snow-light turning every shadow a pale violet. Light: bright white dawn spirit-light from the upper left. Power: a soft light-gold qi glows in the stone and sheds a few motes. Expression: a gentle, unhurried, patient look, eyes narrowed against the glare and the mouth a little parted from the climb.

people.imagined: In the open square at Song Kiều in morning noise, hoarse from shouting the weights; the ledger pad is strapped to his forearm. He holds up a lump of ore for everyone to see.
people.subject: The moment: in an open market square he holds up a lump of dark ore in his right hand and shouts a weight to the crowd, mouth open, voice cracking. Face: a broad, ruddy, honest face; bright brown eyes; thick straight brows; a wide nose; a wide open mouth in a shout, the throat tight; a stubborn square jaw; grey stubble; veins standing in his neck and a drop of sweat hanging from his chin. Hair: black and grey, short, tied under a bronze-grey silk sweat cloth knotted at the back, a grey tuft over the right ear. Body: stocky, strong, big-voiced, chest thrust out. Clothing: a steward's silk, a dark iron-grey over-robe with sleeves rolled to the elbows over a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, crossed collars edged with gold ridge lines; a bronze sash with a yellow jade pendant, a black seven-knot cord, a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: a rough dark lump of ore in the right hand; strapped to the left forearm a flat wooden ledger pad with ruled paper, blank except for tidy tick marks; behind him a large brass balance. Background: a busy square with miners, carts and an open scale, a gold haze of dust. Light: bright morning spirit-light from directly overhead, the shadow of his chin falling sharp across his throat. Power: a faint steel-grey qi gleams on the ore. Expression: an open mouth mid-shout with straining neck and bright earnest eyes, the face red from effort.

people.imagined: At the mint, he has been handed a coin and has bitten it, though he struck it himself. The die-stamp bruise on his thumb is plain. He counts it twice.
people.subject: The moment: at a mint workbench he holds a silver coin between his front teeth in a bite, eyes rolled up suspiciously toward the viewer. Face: a thin, sharp, sallow face; small suspicious dark eyes; thin pinched brows; a long hooked nose; thin lips pulled back around the coin; a thin goatee; a thin sheen of sweat on the forehead. Hair: black and grey, plastered flat with a greased shine, a small knot with a bronze pin. Body: thin, tense, hunched at the bench. Clothing: a steward's silk, a dark iron-grey over-robe with sleeves rolled and cuffed in lacquered black silk over a bronze and earth-gold under-robe, crossed collars edged with gold ridge lines; a bronze sash with a black seven-knot cord, a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects (the bruise must read): on the heel of the right thumb a large dark purple-blue bruise in the shape of a round stamp, plain as the hand holds the coin; on the bench rows of blank silver discs in two exact piles, a small iron die, and a set of small brass scales. Background: a mint workshop with a glowing furnace, dark work-aprons hung on pegs beside it, a long iron die-stamp on its rack, a thin smoke haze. Light: orange furnace glow from the lower left and white spirit-light from a window above. Power: a faint steel-silver qi glints on the coin. Expression: a narrow-eyed, sour, wary look, lips drawn back around the coin, the suspicious attention of a man who counts twice and trusts neither count.
